topic: Changes in Properties of Materials When Mixed
key_concepts: A mixture is two or more materials combined without chemical reaction
No new material is formed in a mixture
Homogeneous mixtures have uniform appearance and indistinguishable components
Solid-solid mixtures can be heterogeneous or homogeneous depending on physical characteris
Some solids dissolve in liquids while others sink or float
Soluble materials dissolve in water; insoluble materials do not
Hot water, stirring, and smaller particle size speed up dissolving
Some liquids mix completely while others like oil and water do not
Temperature affects how fast solids dissolve in liquids
